page.overview:
Who is Coils O'Doom?

Coils O'Doom is a M.A.R.S. Mercenary who often came into conflict with the Adventure Team.

He gained extensive tactical combat and demolitions experience as a soldier for the Defence Forces of Ireland. After being unceremoniously discharged for belligerant activities, he became an elusive saboteur and mercenary for hire. He established countless connections in the criminal underworld, which led him to take a lucrative assignment from the M.A.R.S. corporation.

O'Doom is equally skilled at using a full range of firearms and explosive devices. He's also known to use poisonous snake venom to quickly eradicate his assigned targets. His long-term goal is to pass all his knowledge to his young daughter (who will become Crimson Asp) and train her to continue the family tradition.

Coils O'Doom was a regular adversary of G.I. Joe and the Adventure Team.
